[EN] Faerie Fury

[EN] Kill the {@Creature:47#2002#argonomorph faeries} who are interfering with the planting of faerie saplings.

[ES] Ese no fue un trabajo fácil. Gracias.

[EN] Kill {@creature:47#2002#argonomorph faeries} in the {@Rgn:47015$$Petrified Mushroom Field}.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to {@creature:247#1018$$Lenton} in {@Rgn:47008$$Eastwatch}.
[ES] Informa a {@creature:247#1018$$Lenton} en {@Rgn:47008$$Eastwatch}.
